sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.61 Stable

  • Modular Design Layer: Enhanced variables, styling studio, Mimam's Bar, and plugin management.
  • Media Studio Collections: Integrated collections list with external folder-plugin folders integration (HappyFiles, FileBird, etc.) and asset conversion helpers.
  • Snapshot Improvements: Restorable snapshots, visual titles, and generator cleanup.
  • Removed codebase languages distribution: Removed language bars based on user feedback.
